integrity: All universal assertions are supported by an analytic Legendre coefficient calculation, a rational monotonicity identity, and Schoenberg positivity. Numerical checks are supplementary; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact criterion concerns isotropic signed degree-two Legendre modulation of the classical three-dimensional Poisson kernel, only on S^2 for 0<r<1. No assertion for other sphere dimensions, higher-order multipliers or singular endpoint radii. Historical priority is bounded by examined primary materials and indexed public findings.
title: Sharp ultraviolet positivity threshold for a quadrupole-modulated spherical Poisson kernel
